tool.name: CompareCompression
tool.summary: Validates compression results by comparing baseline and processed GeoTIFF files with side-by-side analysis.

usage.bullet_item: The Baseline file is typically your original, unprocessed GeoTIFF.
The Comparison file is the processed or compressed version you want to validate.

The tool generates an HTML or Markdown report showing file size reduction, compression settings, data integrity validation (min/max/mean), COG validation, metadata changes, and performance implications.
This tool is automatically run after Optimize Compression to validate the compression results.

param.name: baseline_path
param.dialogReference: The baseline (or original) GeoTIFF file to use as the reference for comparison. This is typically your unprocessed or original file before optimization.

param.name: comparison_path
param.dialogReference: The comparison (or processed) GeoTIFF file to validate against the baseline. This is typically the compressed or optimized output file you want to evaluate.

param.name: report_format
param.dialogReference: Output format for the comparison report. Choose HTML (.html) for a rich, interactive report with charts and formatting, or Markdown (.md) for a text-based report suitable for version control and side-by-side comparison.

param.name: report_suffix
param.dialogReference: Suffix to append to the comparison report filename. Default is '_comp' (e.g., 'output_comp.html'). Use a custom suffix to organize multiple reports.

param.name: report_file
param.dialogReference: The full path where the comparison report will be saved. This is automatically derived from the comparison file path and selected format.

param.name: open_report
param.dialogReference: Automatically open the comparison report in your default browser (HTML) or text editor (Markdown) after generation.
